target.title: refactor(browser): trim private Playwright exports
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The unused-export ratchet still carried 26 redundant Playwright re-exports from `extensions/browser/src/browser/pw-ai.ts`. They duplicated symbols owned by the focused Playwright modules and inflated the browser dead-code cluster tracked by #105595.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Remove only the facade re-exports that Knip reports unused.
- Preserve the `pw-ai` exports consumed through the dynamic `PwAiModule` facade.
- Import the browserless live-test cleanup helper from its defining session module.
- Regenerate the baseline against current `main`; after the final rebase, the branch shrinks the ratchet from 5,705 to 5,699 entries while absorbing concurrent baseline drift.

## User Impact

None. Runtime Playwright behavior and the dynamically loaded browser facade remain unchanged; this only narrows internal export surface.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/check-deadcode-exports.mjs --update`
- `node scripts/check-deadcode-exports.mjs` — matched 5,699 entries
- `pnpm test:extension browser` — 147 files passed; 1,945 tests passed; 1 skipped
- `pnpm check:changed` — passed on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcd9ep3jehaj7mw43gerx7m`
- Fresh branch autoreview — no accepted/actionable findings; correctness 0.86

AI-assisted: yes. No transcript attached pending explicit opt-in.

Closes #105595
